genxml.title: constants of the multi-node console and master election
genxml.doc: Constants that the multi-node module system controller arrangement uses: the hub network-interface scratch registers the master election reads, the CPU-letter base of the console line prefix, and the two-wire device family codes of the module and node records on the hub bus. Each is read from the PROM and kernel reading described in the console note. The PROM and kernel payloads that reading used are not among the images available for this check, so the two scratch registers and the letter base are unverified. The two family codes agree with the published 1-Wire family-code list (0x09 and 0x0b are the one-kilobit and sixteen-kilobit add-only memory families); that list was not fetched here.
